remarks: Welcome to 71 Aiken Street, unit Q2, located in the Winnipauk community. This 2 Bed 2.5 bath townhouse has everything you are looking for. Making your way into the home, you are greeted by an open floor plan perfect for entertaining/relaxing, and gives you endless possibilities for layout customization. The living room and dining area are graced with engineered hardwood floors and lead to the eat-in kitchen with ample counter and cabinet space. The living room gives access to the back deck and has a fireplace with a custom mantle. The main level half bath was recently renovated and makes for easy access from any area of the lower level. Heading to the upper level of the home, you will find 2 large bedrooms w/HW floors, and a recently renovated full bath w/tub and luxury vinyl tile. Each bedroom has ample closet space and windows that allow for plenty of natural light to shine in. The primary bedroom boasts 2 large closets, and a full bathroom w/shower. Winnipauk Village is a well-maintained, pet-friendly community that is located near shopping, public transportation, and much more! This community has 2 pools, a clubhouse, tennis courts, a gym, and racquetball courts. Easy access to Merritt Parkway and the train station makes this perfect for the daily or weekend traveler. Assigned parking space #208 is steps from Q2. Don't wait, come see this home today!!
